chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 674: Emperor Projections & Hidden Rulers
chapter_meta_description: Nine Imperial Sovereign projections crush the Spirit Demon Saint Shadow and shatter the tombs of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, but four hidden emperors emerge to contest the Initial Sacred Land.
og_title: A New Age of Emperors Begins in World of Immortality Ch 674
og_description: The Nine Provinces' last hopes are dashed as emperor projections destroy the ancient lamps and a Void Emperor rises from the Death World, joined by three other hidden rulers.
